ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   D. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)
   A. Use Saum , to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs
